name: T1-bugfix-root-collection
instruction: Running `python3 -m pytest` from the repository root fails immediately with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'appium'`, because pytest descends into the vendored third-party `llama.cpp/` directory and imports `llama.cpp/scripts/snapdragon/qdc/tests/conftest.py`. That vendored tree is not ours and must never be collected. Create `pytest.ini` at the repository root so that a bare `python3 -m pytest` collects only this project's own `tests/` directory and never descends into `llama.cpp/`. Take care to use the section header that `pytest.ini` itself requires. Do not change any other file.
verify_cmd: out=$(python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -6; if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'appium'; then exit 1; fi; exit 0

name: T2-tdd-serving-discovery
kind: test-driven change (test written first, held read-only)
instruction: The test file tests/test_sparkrouter_discovery.py already exists and is the specification. It is read-only: do not edit it. Create tools/sparkrouter_discovery.py so every test in it passes. Read the test carefully - it defines two public functions. `parse_serving_flags(cmdline: str) -> dict[str, str | bool]` splits a llama-server command line into a flag map: a flag followed by a non-flag token maps to that token as a string, a flag followed by another flag (or by nothing) maps to True, the leading binary path is not a flag, and an empty or whitespace-only cmdline raises ValueError whose message contains the word 'hint'. `describe(models: dict, props: dict, cmdline: str) -> dict` returns a dict with keys: model_id, n_ctx, n_ctx_train, build_info, total_slots, aider_model (the model_id prefixed with 'openai/'), flags (the parsed flag map), slots_explicit (True only when -np is present), and consistent (True when props['model_path'] equals the -m value from the cmdline). If models['data'] is empty it raises LookupError whose message contains the word 'hint'. Add `from __future__ import annotations`, full type hints on both public functions, and a file header comment. Run nothing; just write the file.

If models['data'] is empty it raises LookupError whose message contains the word 'hint'. Add `from __future__ import annotations`, full type hints on both public functions, and a file header comment. Run nothing; just write the file. tools/sparkrouter_discovery.py

When fastapi IS installed the tests must run exactly as they do now - do not delete, weaken or change any test logic, and do not wrap imports in try/except. Change only those two files.
